title: In Gaza's hospitals, shortages and obstructed evacuations put patients at risk: 'We are forced to use the same catheter 20 or 30 times'
subhead: 95% of the hospitals in the Palestinian enclave have been destroyed or damaged, leaving them desperately short of everything. There are no MRI machines left  and only two CT scanners remain. Around 20,000 patients are on the evacuation list.

title: How Africa is using critical minerals to rebalance geopolitical power

title: Saudi Arabia to invest €6 billion in three theme parks near Paris, one manga-themed

title: Want peace and quiet in France? These are the best places to buy property
subhead: For many people in France, the goal is to hear only the sounds of nature and to avoid being caught up in a tide of tourists. The good news is that in most areas where peace and quiet can still be found, real estate prices remain low.
